adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Pulmonary hemorrhage plus rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis and linear IgG along the GBM identifies anti-GBM disease; the autoantigen is the NC1 domain of the alpha-3 chain of type IV collagen shared by glomerular and alveolar basement membranes.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: COL4A5 is an inherited Alport target, PR3 and MPO are ANCA vasculitis antigens with pauci-immune pathology, and PLA2R is a membranous-nephropathy antigen. None explains the linear IgG pulmonary-renal syndrome.
